scripts.//postinstall: scripts/apply-patches.mjs applies patches/, each listed in patches/patches.json with the exact package version and every file's SHA-256 before and after. motion-dom's puts its feature registry in a module of its own, which keeps framer-motion's animation engine out of the homepage's eager JS (-9,579 B gzipped; docs/performance.md, round 22). Any other motion-dom version or content fails the install: when framer-motion moves, redo the patch (docs/TESTING_INFRASTRUCTURE.md) or drop it once upstream splits the module. npm install <package> skips this script: run npm run postinstall after one that reinstalls motion-dom.
scripts.postinstall: node scripts/apply-patches.mjs && node scripts/setup-assets.js && node scripts/mirror-legacy-pdfs.js
